description: Compare current versus prior windows to find rising and declining exact hooks for an app, vertical, or market slice. Supports an optional semantic query to filter hooks by topic.

language.description: Hook language as ISO 639-1 code(s), comma-separated (default "en"). Use the user's language if they ask about a non-English market, or "any" for all languages. Videos with unknown language are always included.

objective.description: Ranking objective: composite, views, virality, intent, repeatability, shares, bookmarks

query.description: Topic filter (e.g. "meditation sleep", "budgeting tips", "travel vlogs"). Matches hook text by vector similarity and, for market scope, apps in that niche. The result reports topicFilter=applied|fallback|failed; tell the user when it is not "applied".

scope_app_name.description: App name (when scope_type is "app" and ID unknown)

scope_label.description: Display-only title for the result. Does NOT filter anything; put the topic in query or scope_primary_vertical.

scope_primary_vertical.description: Niche when scope_type is "vertical": one word works best (e.g. "meditation", "finance", "journaling", "dating", "education")

scope_type.description: Scope type: "app", "vertical", or "market". For a niche ("meditation apps", "budgeting apps") prefer "vertical" with a one-word scope_primary_vertical; use "market" + query for cross-niche topics.

name: hook_trends

declining.description: Hooks losing use or score versus the comparison window; empty without a trend comparison.

current.description: Videos using the hook in the current window.

delta.description: Change in video count between the comparison window and the current window.

previous.description: Videos using the hook in the comparison window.

scoreDelta.description: Change in weighted score between the comparison window and the current window.

hooks.description: Top hooks ranked by weighted score.

avgViews.description: Average views per video in the group.

confidence.description: How reliable the finding is given its sample size: strong, moderate or weak.

examples.description: Top example videos using this hook.

creator.description: Handle of the creator who posted the example.

platform.description: Platform the example was posted on.

text.description: The hook as written in this example video; null when it matches the hook above.

url.description: Link to the original post of the example.

pattern.description: Short name of the hook pattern (for example Before / after); null when none applies.

platform.description: Platform where this hook appears most.

score.description: Weighted performance score of the group: per-video scores summed, with recent videos weighted higher.

sharePct.description: Percentage of the sampled videos in this group.

kind.description: Panel type; always "hooks" for this tool.

mode.description: intelligence for a hook leaderboard, trends for rising and declining hooks over time.

patterns.description: Hook templates ranked by weighted score.

avgViews.description: Average views per video in the group.

confidence.description: How reliable the finding is given its sample size: strong, moderate or weak.

name.description: Hook template shared by several hooks.

score.description: Weighted performance score of the group: per-video scores summed, with recent videos weighted higher.

sharePct.description: Percentage of the sampled videos in this group.

quality.description: Overall reliability of this scope’s data: strong, moderate or weak.

rising.description: Hooks gaining use or score versus the comparison window; empty without a trend comparison.

current.description: Videos using the hook in the current window.

delta.description: Change in video count between the comparison window and the current window.

previous.description: Videos using the hook in the comparison window.

scoreDelta.description: Change in weighted score between the comparison window and the current window.

title: Find Hook Trends
